records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Introductory Animal Science
records.description: Types and breeds of livestock, terminology, methods, management systems, techniques of animal and poultry production and consumer impact.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Horse Handling
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 101.
records.description: Effective horse handling skills and techniques; safety for both horse and human will be emphasized and prioritized throughout the course.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Dairy Cattle Management Laboratory
records.description: Management practices associated with a dairy enterprise.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Beef Cow Calf Management Laboratory
records.description: Management practices associated with a beef cow calf enterprise for students without experience.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Animal Sciences Orientation
records.description: Animal sciences as a profession; career opportunities, curriculum, advisement, internships, externships, animal centers, special services centers, and course requirements.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Companion Animal Nutrition
records.description: Biological concepts with application in nutrition of pet animals, including evolution and selection of pet species and their nutrient requirements.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Introduction to Domestic Animal Anatomy and Physiology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 101; BIOLOGY 106.
records.description: Fundamental knowledge, terminology and basic principles of domestic animal anatomy and physiology for future advanced courses. The major organ systems (e.g. muscle, skeletal, neural, endocrine, cardiovascular, respiratory, and renal) are covered with emphasis on comparative anatomy, integrated function, and homeostatic control mechanisms.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Live Animal and Carcass Evaluation
records.description: Basic principles of live animal and carcass evaluation.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Equine Management
records.description: Foundational learning of best practices in equine management.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Equine Science
records.description: Fundamental Scientific principles of equine anatomy and physiology including nutrition, reproduction, and muscle biology.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Beef Feedlot Systems
records.description: Overview of feeding management, feed milling and batching, animal health, and economics of the commercial cattle feeding business. One 1-day field trip.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Animal Science and Society: Current Topics
records.description: A discussion of the products, science, and management of animal agriculture and how they relate to, and impact, society.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Rights and Welfare of Animals
records.description: Ethical considerations and welfare of animals used as companions, for food, and in scientific research. Recommended preparation: BIOLOGY 102 or 106 or concurrent enrollment.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Feeds and Feeding
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; MATH 106, 108, 140, 171, 172, 182, or 202.
records.description: Utilization, practices, requirements, nutritive characteristics, and calculations of rations for animals. Field trip required.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Principles of Nutrition
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 107; CHEM 102 or 106.
records.description: Digestion, absorption, metabolism, and function of nutrients.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Captive Exotic Animal Nutrition, Husbandry and Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 205, ANIM SCI 314, or SOE 431.
records.description: Nutrition, husbandry, and management of captive exotic animals emphasizing the requirements of the animal environment.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Animal Genetics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 107; STAT 212.
records.description: Basic genetic concepts and methods for the genetic improvement of Mendelian and polygenic traits in animals.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Animal Growth and Development
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; BIOLOGY 107; junior standing.
records.description: Animal structure, composition, whole body and cellular growth, prenatal and postnatal growth; emphasis on skeletal muscle, bone and adipose tissue.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Physiology of Reproduction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; BIOLOGY 107; CHEM 102 or 106.
records.description: Anatomy and physiology of reproductive organs; hormones of reproduction; production of gametes; artificial insemination; fertilization; prenatal development; fertility and infertility.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Physiology of Reproduction Laboratory
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 350 or concurrent enrollment.
records.description: Laboratory and field techniques used in animal reproduction involving hormones, artificial insemination, semen evaluation and pregnancy.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Meat Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 107.
records.description: Anatomy, slaughter, classification, and processing of meat animal species. Special clothing and equipment required.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Advanced Livestock and Meat Selection and Evaluation
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 260.
records.description: Principles and practices of livestock and meat selection and evaluation. Off-campus and weekend participation required.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Careers in Animal Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Animal Sciences; junior standing.
records.description: Issues and preparation for careers in animal sciences areas.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Practicum
records.description: Directed internship in livestock production and related fields conducted at WSU centers on or off campus.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Ciders and Other Fermented Foods
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106 and 107, or MBIOS 101, or MBIOS 304 and 305.
records.description: Chemistry, microbiology, and technology associated with the production of cider, beer, and other food fermentations.  Recommended preparation: FS 304 and 465. (Crosslisted course offered as FS 405, ANIM SCI 405.)

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Ruminant Nutrition
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 313.
records.description: Anatomy, physiology, and metabolism in ruminant animals.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Physiology of Domestic Animals
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; BIOLOGY 107.
records.description: Basic animal functions; relationship and difference between domestic animals; measurement of functional processes.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Endocrine Physiology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; BIOLOGY 107; one of the following: ANIM SCI 440, BIOLOGY 352, MBIOS 303, or MBIOS 401.
records.description: Anatomy, physiology, and biochemistry of endocrine systems and hormone action; emphasis on comparative, veterinary, and biomedical models. Credit not granted for both ANIM SCI 451 and ANIM SCI 551.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Biomedical Science and Human/Animal Health: Underlying Science, Diagnosis, and Therapies of Diseases
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 330 or MBIOS 301; ANIM SCI 345 or 350 or BIOLOGY 475; MBIOS 303 or 401 or 404.
records.description: Biomedical aspects of health outcomes; mechanisms and fundamental principles of diagnostic techniques and professional skills.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Artificial Insemination and Pregnancy Detection
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 351.
records.description: Techniques in semen handling, insemination and pregnancy detection in cattle. Special clothing required.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Advanced Meat Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: CHEM 102 or 106; junior standing.
records.description: Structure and development of skeletal muscle, postmortem biological changes, meat quality, meat processing, food safety, and meat industry.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Companion Animal Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 313; ANIM SCI 330; ANIM SCI 350; junior standing.
records.description: Care and management of companion animal species throughout the life cycle, including nutrition, reproduction, exercise and behavior.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Advanced Equine Systems
records.prerequisiteText: Course prerequisite: ANIM SCI 266 or ANIM SCI 267; ANIM SCI 313; ANIM SCI 330; ANIM SCI 350; ANIM SCI 351.
records.description: Integrating Animal Sciences disciplines with real-world issues involving horse businesses.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Applied Physiology of Cultured Fish
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 313; ANIM SCI 330; ANIM SCI 350.
records.description: Development and management of finfish aquaculture systems and production strategies.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Dairy Cattle Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 313; ANIM SCI 330; ANIM SCI 350; junior standing.
records.description: Principles of breeding, feeding, and management of dairy cattle. Field trip required.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Beef Cattle Production
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: ANIM SCI 313; ANIM SCI 330; ANIM SCI 350; junior standing.
records.description: Breeding, feeding, and management; commercial and purebred enterprises; management of beef cattle on ranges, pastures and in the feedlot. Field trip required.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Special Topics in Study Abroad: Animal Production Systems in the World
records.description: Immersive course integrating experiential learning activities in animal production systems into international locations where ANIM SCI Faculty are already working and conducting research.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Applied Animal Behavior
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 106; BIOLOGY 107; STAT 212; junior standing.
records.description: Application of scientific principles governing animal behavior to practical aspects of animal housing, breeding, handling, training, and care.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Perspectives in Biotechnology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MBIOS 301 or ANIM SCI 330.
records.description: Theory and application of biotechnology in agriculture, industry, and medicine; methodological, environmental, social, and economic concerns. Credit not granted for both ANIM SCI 488 and ANIM SCI 588.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Research in Animal Sciences
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Junior standing.
records.description: Planned and supervised undergraduate research experience.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: ANIM_SCI
records.title: Special Problems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By department permission.
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
